transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I have this intense, overwhelming fear of dogs that I just can't seem to control. It's really starting to take over my life, and I just don't know what to do anymore.
Do you find yourself actively avoiding places like parks or neighborhoods where you might encounter dogs, and does this fear cause you significant distress or interfere with your daily routine?

Yes, absolutely. I constantly avoid parks, specific streets, and change my walking routes entirely just to make sure I don't run into any dogs. It's incredibly stressful and has severely restricted my daily routine, making even simple things like walking to work a constant struggle.
How long have you been experiencing this intense fear of dogs, and has it been present for at least six months?

Yes, I've been dealing with this intense fear of dogs for about a year and eight months now. It has definitely been going on for much longer than six months, and it doesn't seem to be getting any better.
